name: runtime-financial-gates-dispatch-readiness
objective: Make governed financial runtime mutations usable in dev/test, fail closed correctly in production configuration, and prove dispatch/outbox integration consumes canonical WLT truth exactly once.
truthOwner: WLT owns mutation gating/provider state/dispatch financial eligibility; DSH consumes decisions/evidence and retries idempotently.

tasks.objective: Wire governed financial DecisionService/runtime policy so configured dev/test mutation can execute while missing/deny/unhealthy dependencies remain fail-closed and observable.
tasks.currentProblem: The historical nil-DecisionService defect is resolved on the current base by concurrent work that added NewConfiguredDecisionServiceFromEnv and wired it in cmd/wlt-api, but readiness/observability still do not expose the decision dependency state, so an absent or unhealthy dependency is not visible before mutations are attempted.
tasks.requiredChange: Verify and carry forward the landed governed decision dependency as evidence, then close the remaining gap by exposing decision-dependency state in readiness/observability and proving the deny and unavailable paths stay fail-closed.
tasks.targetState: Runtime can intentionally allow valid non-production financial tests without bypassing the kill switch, and readiness reports the decision dependency honestly.
tasks.action: Re-verify the landed EnforceKillSwitch and NewConfiguredDecisionServiceFromEnv wiring against the current base instead of re-implementing it, then add the decision-dependency state to the health/readiness surface and add deny and unavailable regression coverage; record the already-landed wiring as concurrent-work evidence rather than as this package's delta.
mustNotChange: Do not replace fail-closed with allow-by-default.
Do not hardcode a permanent dev bypass.
Do not report readiness while required decision dependency is absent.
acceptanceCriteria: Configured allow path works in dev/test.
tasks.rollback: Disable mutations fail-closed; never fallback permissively.

tasks.objective: Re-prove provider rail mode isolation and unknown-result recovery on current candidate.
tasks.currentProblem: Historical unit evidence is stale and provider behavior cannot be considered proven while runtime mutation was blocked upstream.
tasks.requiredChange: Run configured simulator/non-production mode, verify production forbids mock fallback and reconcile ambiguous external results before any new mutation.
tasks.targetState: Provider effects are mode-safe, journaled and exactly-once/reconcilable.
tasks.action: Assert the provider rail resolves its mode from explicit non-production configuration with no production fallback, journal every external attempt before it is issued, and require an ambiguous or unknown external result to pass through reconciliation before any further external mutation on the same financial identity.
mustNotChange: Do not enable simulator fallback in production.
Do not blindly retry UNKNOWN external mutation.
Do not mark success without authoritative provider evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulator only in explicit non-production mode.
Unknown result reconciles before another external mutation.
tasks.rollback: Fail closed and retain provider journal/reconciliation state.
tasks.commitBoundary: One provider-readiness commit if code changes are required.

tasks.objective: Bind dispatch financial eligibility to canonical wallet projection and prove DSH honors context/policy/TTL without local finance calculation.
tasks.currentProblem: Eligibility currently reads wlt_wallets and must be re-proven after canonical wallet convergence; DSH consumption freshness is not closed.
tasks.requiredChange: Use canonical projection, trusted context, versioned policy and bounded expiry; DSH consumes decision as financial fact without threshold/balance recomputation.
tasks.targetState: Dispatch cannot proceed on stale/revoked/cross-context financial eligibility.
tasks.action: Repoint the eligibility evaluation from a direct wlt_wallets read onto the canonical wallet projection delivered by U006, resolve the operator context from the trusted boundary, stamp each Decision with the policy version and a bounded expiry, and assert on the DSH side that the decision is consumed as an opaque financial fact with no local threshold or balance recomputation.
mustNotChange: Do not move financial eligibility calculation into DSH.
acceptanceCriteria: Policy/wallet change produces fresh governed decision.
tasks.rollback: Block dispatch financial eligibility until a fresh WLT decision is available.

tasks.objective: Prove DSH financial proxy/outbox timeout, duplicate delivery and restart converge to one WLT effect with stable identity/correlation.
tasks.currentProblem: End-to-end retries can duplicate or lose money effects unless business identity survives DSH/WLT/runtime failure boundaries.
tasks.requiredChange: Persist/reuse idempotency/correlation, distinguish unknown result from safe retry, and recover durable pending work after restart.
tasks.targetState: Every DSH-triggered financial operation converges to exactly one canonical WLT result.
tasks.action: Persist the idempotency and correlation identity with the outbox record so a retry reuses it instead of generating a new one, classify transport timeout as an unknown result that blocks further attempts until reconciliation resolves it, and recover durable pending outbox work on restart with a canonical WLT readback before the record is closed.
mustNotChange: Do not generate a new idempotency key on retry.
Do not infer financial success from transport success alone.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate delivery produces one WLT effect.
Unknown external result is not blindly retried.
Restart recovers durable pending work and canonical readback.
tasks.rollback: Leave pending/unknown work durable and blocked for reconciliation.
